name: age
meaning: age in ticks (g_dt units), bits 0..23 (Emitter_UpdateDrift 0x52cadd and edx,0xffffff)

name: grey
meaning: grey level splatted to all three channels for the vertex diffuse, bits 24..31 (Emitter_AddParticle 0x52c6cd..0x52c6ea)

name: frame
meaning: frame index into the sprite sheet, bits 24..30 (Emitter_AddParticle 0x52c6ec..0x52c707)

name: alive
meaning: bit 31 (Emitter_AddParticle 0x52c6c2 or eax,0x80000000; UpdateDrift 0x52caca shr eax,0x1f)
